name: Suitcase Carry
instructions: Hold a heavy dumbbell in one hand at your side.
Stand tall — resist leaning away from the weight.
Brace your core hard, especially the obliques on the loaded side.
Walk slowly with controlled steps for the prescribed distance, then switch hands.
cues: Grip hard, breathe behind the brace
longevityNotes: Grip strength and loaded walking correlate strongly with longevity. Carries are simple, safe, and brutally effective — do them often.
overview: A beginner loaded carry with dumbbells for the abs. Suitcase Carry builds the grip, core, and postural strength used every time you haul groceries or luggage.
